name: session-telemetry
description: Live telemetry for a session: agents, cost, tokens, context window, tools and data flow.

alertsEnabled.title: Telemetry alerts
alertsEnabled.description: quiet: alerts are kept for the pane and the status line, and only critical ones (context at 90%, budget spent) raise a toast; all: warnings raise a toast too; off: no alerts

budgetUsd.title: Session budget (USD)
budgetUsd.description: Warn at 80% and alert at 100% of this session's cost; 0 turns the budget alert off

contextWarnPct.title: Context warning (%)
contextWarnPct.description: Warn when the context reaches this share of the auto-compact threshold (of the window when auto-compact is off); 90% is always critical

burnSpikeMultiplier.title: Burn spike multiplier
burnSpikeMultiplier.description: Warn when the 5-minute burn rate is over this many times the median minute of the last 15 minutes (and at least $0.05/min)

statusLine.title: Telemetry status line
statusLine.description: Pin a compact line under the prompt: cost, context fill, running agents, the cache clock and the top alert
